about.photo_alt: Beam Excavating equipment on a job site
about.title: Local, family owned since 2004
paragraphs: Beam Excavating is a local, family-owned business operating in the entire Columbia Gorge. We started in 2004 with smaller projects and grew into significant undertakings, including our biggest project to date: a waterline stretching through downtown Hood River.

Chad Beam, owner and founder, is from Hood River and keeps great relationships with his clients. Our crew brings decades of experience in septic systems, precision grading, pipe work and commercial projects.
Because we are local, we support local. Beam backs fundraisers, high school events and local causes, because we believe in growing our community one job at a time.

estimate.title: Let us help
estimate.text: Give us a call or send us the details. We'd love to work up a complimentary estimate for you.
estimate.thanks: We got your project details and will get back to you as soon as we can.

services.name: Land Clearing & Site Prep
services.blurb: Clearing, grading and prep for homes, garages and arenas.
services.intro: Just bought the property of your dreams? We clear your land and prep it for whatever you want to use it for. Our GPS grading technology saves you time and money.

services.name: Underground Utilities
services.blurb: Trenching, conduit and pipe replacement and installation.
services.intro: Sometimes things break, including underground utilities. We replace conduit and piping, and excavate and backfill trenching for new utilities.

services.name: Water & Sewer Systems
services.blurb: Water main, storm, sewer and public works piping.
services.intro: We have the commercial capabilities and experience to lay water main, storm, sewer and most other public works piping.

services.name: Septic Systems
services.blurb: New septic systems and drain fields.
services.intro: We've been installing septic systems and drain fields since 2004, and we prioritize our clients even after installation. Our sister company, A-1 Septic Tank Service, handles pumping and inspections.
includes: Septic pumping via A-1 Septic Tank Service

services.name: Road Construction & Driveways
services.intro: From private drives to roadways, we build roads that last, like the 2,000-foot driveway we graded and compacted through Mt. View Orchards.

services.name: Demolition & Trucking
services.blurb: Demolition, plus hauling gravel, bark and fill dirt.
services.intro: Not only can we build it, we can demolish it too. And if you need gravel, bark or fill dirt hauled in, we can help you spread it.
includes: Gravel, bark and fill dirt hauling
